product_overview: AI-Spark Dashboard is a single-page AI-focused dashboard that presents insight widgets and usage statistics. It also includes an interactive quiz experience that users can launch from the main dashboard.
core_goals: Review AI dashboard insights and statistics
Launch and complete an in-app quiz experience
View quiz results and completion feedback

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: Lets users review the main dashboard content, including AI insight widgets and usage statistics.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll through the dashboard -> View AI insight widgets -> Review usage statistics such as API usage and queries

features.name: Quiz System
features.description: Lets users start an interactive quiz from the dashboard, answer questions in a modal, and receive completion feedback.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Start the quiz -> Answer the quiz questions -> Submit the quiz -> See results and completion confetti
